title: Can 1,000 Open Scenes Make a State-of-the-Art 3D Model Better?
subtitle: Assessing the OVER Dataset by Fine-Tuning a 3D Foundation Model on Its Open Sample
description: An empirical assessment of the OVER dataset for research, run entirely on OverMaps-1k — the open 1,000-scene sample anyone can download from Hugging Face: pose accuracy improves visibly on our domain, catastrophic forgetting is measured and defused through WiSE weight merging, and a scaling analysis shows how much data the gain requires.
author: OVER Research
